values.name: loops
comment: a link to the same row or an earlier one is a loop back only if its target leads round to its
source; any other link runs down the chart, so its target goes below it

values.name: reached

*Signing in: a decision with a retry loop back up the chart.*

- Start → Enter name and password
- Enter name and password → Correct?
- Correct? → Show the home page (yes); Three tries used? (no)
- Three tries used? → Enter name and password (no); Lock the account (yes)
- Show the home page → End
- Lock the account → End
- End

*Signing in: a decision with a retry loop back up the chart.*

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  start(["Start"])
  ask[/"Enter name and password"/]
  check{"Correct?"}
  tries{"Three tries used?"}
  home["Show the home page"]
  lock["Lock the account"]
  done(["End"])
  start --> ask
  ask --> check
  check -->|yes| home
  check -->|no| tries
  tries -->|no| ask
  tries -->|yes| lock
  home --> done
  lock --> done
```
